_comment: Source of truth for OpenClaw skills.limits (spec 188, issue #326). OpenClaw defaults: 200 loaded per source, 300 candidates, 150 in prompt, 18000 prompt chars; the workspace ships more, so the excess was silently never loaded. Installers apply these raise-only; scripts/check-skill-limits.py (reconcile surface skill-limits) fails when the shipped skills exceed them. Raise these here when adding skills past the headroom.
